in_sanskrit.name: परशुराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rama, who is pleased while wielding an axe

in_marathi.name: Parashurama
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rama with axe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parashurama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parashurama was an incarnation of Lord Vishnu. He was born to Rishi Jamadagni and his wife Renuka, as a vow fulfilled by their son. Famed for his bravery, he wielded an axe and destroyed the Kshatriya rulers 21 times to restore the balance between the Kshatriyas and the Brahmins.

in_bengali.name: Parashurama
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Rama with axe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Parashurama একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Parashurama was an incarnation of Lord Vishnu. He was born to Rishi Jamadagni and his wife Renuka, as a vow fulfilled by their son. Famed for his bravery, he wielded an axe and destroyed the Kshatriya rulers 21 times to restore the balance between the Kshatriyas and the Brahmins.
